facts.title: SatoriUI
facts.description: A comprehensive suite of high-fidelity, interactive, accessible and extensible components to use with shadcn/ui.

research.name: SatoriUI
research.note: Copy-paste React components with physics-based motion, including an interactive keyboard, flip clock and shader backgrounds.

effects: Keyboard UI: an interactive laptop-style keyboard whose keys light up as you type

unverified: The source appears to be github.com/Harit007x/satoriui, whose app routes match the site's components (keyboard-ui, flip-clock, cyberpunk-button, beacon-badge, pulse-button), but the site does not link it and the repository has no license file even though the site says MIT; that repository has not been researched in place of this site yet.
The date comes from that repository's newest commit, not from the site, whose Changelog and Pricing links return 404.
The Dotted Modern background embeds code from ibelick/background-snippets, so not every component is original.
